content: Yirat Jon baptais kwiydi duwaam viyasipadid.
Ababa duw taakw wabagwudiy Jisas dikidiy kwurdidiy yawiyik. Alik Juw dayadi yitaypika duw, Yirat, adiy yawiy wukididiy.
Wukikuw, di dikidiy bapa duwak ata wadidiy, “Jon Baptais kwiydi duw tayir diki abw wun viyalupwa-tuwik, kiyaad. Aw kita bwutaay rasinaad kawamiyaam kwakuw. Alik ki nima ap dim rina.”

Tayir Yirat kiradil Yirawtiyas, dikidi nyamwus Pilip diki taakw. Jon Baptais kwiydi duw Yiratak wadikalib, “God maa wanaad min minadi nyamwus diki taakw kiraminil.” Yirawtiyas pitaan warkuw Jonak, li dim viyasipak. Alik Yirawtiyas kwurik, Yirat duw wayakididiy Jon kwurin yaav jikuw mala wiyaam takadakik. Yirat Jonaam viyasipak waad. Aw adiy Juw tipa kidiy duw taakw day wadiy, “Jon di God diki maaj wasapwiydi duwad.” Alik Yirat di Jonaam viyasipa viyasipak yagaad.

Yirat diki maaj kwadil nyi tilik, di kikipaat jabim takanadiy sapakwa nyanugw kidakikik. Yirawtiyas liki takwa nyan yaan baagw dayak tilik, Yirat rakarak samasam tad likik. Alik di basa kasab wadil, “Mwiya maaj watuwanyin. Agwa jaav nyina mawul kwurik walik, wun kwatiyaribaak tinadiwun.”

Aal nibwu taakw wakwukuw, liki amayik bas silil, “Agwa javik bas sikituwa?” Tayir Jon Yiratak kipwu mwutaam yikuw, mwiya maa waad di Yirawtiyas kira-kirak. Yirawtiyas a jaav wukil, alik liki takwa nyinik ata walil, “Baptais kwiydi duw diki abw.” Jayib ni a nibwu taakw sibinin yikuw Yiratak, dikik ata walid, “Baptais kwiydi duw, Jon, diki abw kita viyalupwakuw, marim takakuw, wunak akwutay.”
Yirat ata samasam wukid diki abanik. Di bwu takadil vagaluwdiy duw makab. Maaj lakatiykuw, alik ginyir maa rav warapiyik. Atawa tikuw, di yaakiya waad dikik walil majik.
Yirat vay sawdiy duwak ata wadidiy, “Jon Baptais kwiydi duw diki abw aviyalupw.”
Viyalupwakuw, Jon diki abw marim takakuw, nibwu takwak kwiydil. Li ata kwurkuw, karayin liki amayik kwiylil.
Jon dikidiy kalivadidiy duw a jaav wukikuw, day yakuw, Jon diki amwiy kwurdaal. Kwurkuw, kawamiyaam takadaal. Takakuw, day ata Jisasak yidiy dikik ababa jaav wakir.
Jisas samasama duw takwak kamnaagw kwiydidiy.
Jisas daya maaj wukikuw, a tip ata wapakuw, di kap yad kipa tamiyaar jabirasaay. Jisas a tip wapadil maaj wukikuw, samasama duw taakw diki kwukir manir nibwusaay yidiy dikik.
Jisas jabir wapakuw, adiy samasama vagaluwdiy duw takwaam vikuw, di samasam wukid dayak. Wukikuw, di dayadiy giviyib kwurdiy duw takwawa nyanugw sipwutiy-didiy.
Giraab tilik, dikidiy kalivadidiy duw dikik yakuw, wadaad, “Kal kipa tamiya. Giraab bwu tina. Kidiy duw taakw tipaar awayak. Yin kikipaat mawiy yapiy-kwadiy day daya.”
Jisas dayak ata wadidiy, “Wun dayaam tipaam wayak maa. Gwur gwura dayak kikipaat akwiy.”
Day Jisasak ata wadaad, “Nyan kilim kikipaat samasam maa ri. Bret tabab, kamiy vitiyada rinadiy.”
Jisas dayak ata wadidiy, “Adiy kikipaat wunak akaray.”

Di adiy vagaluwdiy duw takwak ata wadidiy, “Gwur visim daan ada.” Wadik, day visim daan ridaak, Jisas adiy bret tababawa vitiya kamiy kwurkuw, adawul tipaar likituwkuw, Godak wayapiy sidid. Wayapiy sikuw, adiy bret kaysukwa-sukwakuw, kwiydidiy dikidiy kalivadidiy duwak adiy vagaluwdiy duw takwak kwiydakik.
Ababa duw taakw kikipaat kikuw, yaal wapwudiy. Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duw kayvisi-dadiy kipaat vagakuw, baniy tabatiy maan vitiy vagadaak, kapwudiy.
5000 duw adiy bret awa kamiy kidiy. Day takwawa nyanugw maa naas.
Jisas apiy araar yad.
Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duwak ata wadidiy, “Gwur jabiraar awar. Warkuw, gwur taay maay apika maka araar.” Wakuw, di ata vagaluwdiy duw taakw wayakididiy.

Wayakidik, yidaak, di nibwukir ata warid. Warkuw, Godawa maaj bwulaad. Gaan valik, Jisas kap kwaad kupwaam. Gaan valik, adi jabir nyidi araam tidik, mwar nimadib yin jabiraam saylik adi jabir payparapwud.
Taay tapwuk wadidi gaan Jisas apiy ararib dayak yad.
Aw Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duw dim apiy guwarib yadik vikuw, samasam yagakuw, ata wadiy, “Kad apawul-ad?” Yagakuw, nimadib gaam sidiy.
Jisas yabiyib dayak ata wadidiy, “Gwuradiy mawul yaga-tikwa. Wun Jisas-adiwun. Yaga-tikwa.”
Pita Jisasak ata wadid, “Li min mwiya Jisas-adimin wakuw, wunak wamin, wunabab wakwun guwarib vasin yaaw minak.”
Jisas Pitak ata wadid, “May.” Wadik, Pita ata jabiraam tikuw, guwaar sarin daad. Dakuw, apiy guwarib Jisasak ata yad.
Aw Pita di nima mwurawa mam yalik, di vikuw, yagaad mawulaar. Di ata kwasa kwasa guwaar daad. Aw di Jisasak gaam sidid, “Yitaypika Duw, wunak sugwiyaan akwur!”
Jisas yabiyib dikidi taab kwusakakuw, Pita kaykitidid.
Bir ata jabiraar sarin warbir, mwar ata kwusir.
Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duw jabiraam kwakuw, gaba maaj sukwudiy Jisasak, “Min mwiya God dikidi Nyan-adimin!” wakuw.
Jisas barik kwurdiy duw taakw sipwutiy-didiy Ginisarit tamiyaam.
Day araar suwurkuw, Ginisaritaar yadiy. Alim day kawiydiy.

Alim duw taakw day Jisasaam vikuw, day “Kad Jisas-ad” wataay wadiy. Aw day maaj wayakidaal walibab ridiy tipaar aw ababa duw taakw day dayadiy giviyib kwurdiy duw taakw Jisasak kwurin kariya-dakik. Day ata jabir jabir bas sidaad diki wapwiyim kaykiti-dakik. Kaykitikuw, day ata viyakit tidiy.
